name: Chandrapur
registryAssessment: Chandrapur District Administration publishes an E-Mahabhumi land-records route that links to Maharashtra's official Bhumi Abhilekh portal with districtId=37. The district's Marathi land branch documents survey-number maps, village maps and land-records offices, including the Deputy Superintendent of Land Records, and identifies the Collector/Sub-Divisional Officer/Tahsildar workflow. This evidences a local/state cadastral service custodian, but not an open parcel-vector integration.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; viewer timeout and unavailable public response do not establish citywide absence.
